register_worker_with_worker_pool: register a new worker with the WorkerPool by providing crowd data and a request ID
register_agent_with_worker_pool: register an agent for a worker in the WorkerPool after authorization and qualification checks
reconnect_agent_in_worker_pool: reconnect a previously registered agent to the WorkerPool and resend its task initialization data
assign_unit_to_agent: assign a task unit to an agent in the WorkerPool and launch the unit execution
handle_updated_agent_status: handle status updates for agents in the WorkerPool by processing a status map and pushing updates
